info.max_stay: Caps how many nights the route stays in one place. Lower = more stops and variety, higher = fewer moves.
info.trip_duration: Number of travel days. Filled in automatically once you pick travel dates with an end date.
info.radius: How far around your place we look for better weather (straight-line distance). A larger radius finds more places but takes longer to load.
info.granularity: "Auto" picks a place size that fits the search area. "Cities only" is fast and coarse, "All places" also finds villages but takes longer.
info.score: The score (0–100) combines sunshine, rain, temperature and wind, weighted by your weather profile. 100 would be perfect weather for your profile.
info.custom_weights: Choose how much sunshine, rain, temperature and wind count towards the score. Sliders are normalised to 100% automatically.
